notes: Manifest v69 makes mobile composer collapse actually release its panel footprint. Expanded height is still measured only from expanded geometry to prevent cumulative drift, but collapsed state is a fixed 18px toggle rail with the composer hidden and backdrop blur removed. The message viewport therefore expands into the released lower area while the fixed 10px workspace gutter remains unchanged. CLIENT /chat -> SERVER /api/chat transport ownership and runtime source ownership are unchanged; no redeploy or restart is required.
